grid: 16 chars = 1 bar of 16ths; X 120, x 92, g 45, o 88, O 112, . rest, digits 1-9 = velocity tenths; | separates bars
note: Numbers come from knowledge/lanes/<id>.md (sources inside). Recommendations only: the user decides every move.

lanes.name: Melodic house and techno (Afterlife, Anyma, ARTBAT)
lanes.laws: kick every beat; one chord per 2 bars; the lead melody is the drop; breakdown as long as the drop

bass.hint: roots; pulse in drop 1, roll in drop 2; sub sine one note per bar; sidechainDb 8 release 150

harmony.pad: fatsawtooth unison 3 spread 26 cutoff 1200-2400 attack 0.6 width 0.9 -12 dB

references: Anyma & Grimes - Welcome To The Opera (2023, 125, F minor): the melody is the drop
ARTBAT - Horizon (2020, 124, F minor): bass and arp locked on roots
Solee - Pink Panther (2017, 123, E major; in his crate): pluck hook mutates every 8 bars

feelWords.epic: pad attack 0.8, strings pad +1 oct -18, reverb 0.4, breakdown 32, master lowpass 16 bars
feelWords.darker: i-iv-v-bIII, pad cutoff 800, sub octave, hats -3 dB
feelWords.emotional: 2 bars per chord, lead on the 9th, no openhat, velVar 0.1
feelWords.spacey: arp delay 8n. wet 0.35 width 1, pad cutoff 4000
feelWords.hypnotic: i-bVII loop, no clap, ride quarters, automation only 32 bars

lanes.name: Afro house (Keinemusik, Black Coffee) + amapiano and 3-step
lanes.laws: soft kick; percussion carries it; drops arrive (0.85) not blast; amapiano 112 with a log drum; 3-step = three kicks per bar

bass.hint: root dur 1.5, pickups to the 5th, iv in bar 2; log drum = triangle cutoff 350 res 5 env 2.5 decay 0.1 drive 0.35 midi 40-50; sidechainDb 4

references: Adam Port, Stryv & Malachiii - Move (2024, 120, Ab minor): chant, arrival drop
&ME, Rampa, Adam Port - Muye (2018, 120, A minor): chant + perc bed
Black Coffee & Guetta - Drive (2018, 118, F# minor): deep bass, pop vocal
Tyler ICU - Mnike (2023, 113, F minor): log drum

feelWords.warmer: bass sustain 0.7 cutoff 400, chords cutoff 1800, no openhat
feelWords.amapiano: tempo 112, sparse kick, log drum, straight shaker, epiano 2-5-1
feelWords.3-step: tempo 116, kick3step, roll fills, log drum
feelWords.chant: recordHum chords 8 beats, pad drone, no clap

lanes.name: Deep house and piano house (MAW, Kerri Chandler, Duke Dumont, Shouse)
lanes.laws: round kick every beat; m7 and m9 chords, keep every 7th; grooves not blasts (drop 1 = 0.9); Rhodes stabs on and-of-1 and and-of-3

bass.hint: walk = root 1, root and-of-2, 5th, b7; organ = wave organ octave -1 sustain 0.8 (M1 / Show Me Love); sub sine roots; sidechainDb 5

harmony.stabs: epiano steps 3 and 11 dur 0.3 delay 8n. wet 0.15 eq low -3
harmony.pianoHouse: epiano stabs every offbeat 8th, organ chords -10 dB

references: Shouse - Love Tonight (2017, 123, C minor; in his crate): one vocal, four chords
Duke Dumont - Need U (100%) (2013, 124, F minor): piano stabs, chop, organ bass
Route 94 - My Love (2014, 120, Ab major): sub bass, Rhodes, filtered vocal

feelWords.deeper: epiano cutoff 1400, longer bass, no openhat, LUFS -10, pad -16
feelWords.piano house: epiano offbeat stabs, organ bass, chop, tempo 124
feelWords.smoother: velVar 0.05, no tom, pad -14, stabs dur 0.4

lanes.name: UK garage 2-step (MJ Cole, Artful Dodger, PinkPantheress)
lanes.laws: kick on 1 and the and-of-3 only; snare 2 and 4; every offbeat swings; sub-led, little sidechain; transpose +1 for the last drop

bass.hint: dred = reverse-swell riff root b7 5th over 8 bars; organ = wave organ octave -1 sustain 0.8; sub sine 2 oct down on 1 and a-of-3; sidechainDb 3

harmony.chords: epiano or organ 9ths on steps 7 and 12, delay 8n wet 0.12

references: Artful Dodger - Re-Rewind (1999, 130, E minor): the 2-step skip under R&B vocal
MJ Cole - Sincere (1998, 132, Ab major): jazz chords, rolling bass
PinkPantheress - Boy's a liar (2022, 133, F major): revival, pluck hook, 2-minute form

feelWords.skippy: swing 0.64, ghost hats steps 6 and 14, rim call-response
feelWords.darker: dred cutoff 150 res 6, no epiano, sub -1 oct
feelWords.bubbly: major key, epiano 9ths, chop +3 st, pluck
feelWords.4x4: kick every beat: hard-house drums, keep the chords
feelWords.old school: organ bass and chords, tempo 130, crackle perc crush 8
feelWords.pinkpantheress: tempo 133, 16th pluck, breathy vocal, drop at bar 9

lanes.name: Jersey club (MCVertt, DJ Sliink; R-You / DJ TAJ / BERGE edits)
lanes.laws: five kicks per bar at 16th steps 1,5,9,12,15 (4-4-3-3-2); snare against the run; hats on 2 and 4 only; 808 follows the kick; straight; short records

drums.roll: 8th-triplet hats last beat of bars 4 and 8 (stepBeats 0.3333) vel 5,7,9

bass.hint: 808 on the kick steps, root 4 bars then bIII and bII (NI: F2, G#2, G2); sub sine on 1 and 9; sidechainDb 2

progressions: root-octave hits on the kick rhythm
source I-V-vi-IV in the breakdown only
harmony.stabs: fatsawtooth unison 2 decay 0.15 on the kick grid

references: Lil Uzi Vert - Just Wanna Rock (2022, 150, F# minor; MCVertt): chant + kick + 808
Drake - Sticky (2022, 137, F# major): rap vocal on a Jersey grid
Cookiee Kawaii - Vibe (2019, listed 160, A# major): vocal-first Jersey

feelWords.bouncier: ghost at step 14, 808 glide 0.08, 5th kick vel 90
feelWords.harder: kick drive 0.5 drumTune -2, snare +3 dB, crash every drop bar 1
feelWords.drill: tempo 145-166, sliding 808 on 1 and and-of-3, triplet hats
feelWords.flip: warp vocal to 140, 2-syllable stabs on steps 3 and 7

lanes.name: Trap and hip-hop club edits, written at double time
lanes.laws: grid BPM = 2x felt (150 = 75); snare on beat 3 only; kick sparse; the 808 is bass and sub, duck false; lane-gate the kickDensity>=3 check

bass.hint: root on 1 dur 2, pickup a-of-3, 5th or b7 on and-of-4 of bar 2; one slide per 4 bars (overlapping notes); no sub track; kick drumTune +3 decay 0.18

harmony.pad: pwm unison 2 cutoff 1400 -14 dB reverb 0.4 width 0.9
harmony.bells: sine decay 0.4 delay 4n wet 0.2; counter on root, octave, 5th, b7

references: Future - Mask Off (2017, 150 / 75 felt, D minor): flute loop over sparse 808s
Travis Scott - FE!N (2023, 148, Eb minor measured): one stab riff + chant
Playboi Carti - Magnolia (2017, 163, E minor): the bounce, 808 slides

feelWords.harder: 808 drive 0.6, kick drumTune +2 vol +1, clap +2 dB
feelWords.darker: i-bII pad cutoff 900, bells -1 oct, reverb 0.5
feelWords.bouncier: 808 pickups steps 12 and 16, glide 0.1, triplet rolls, tempo 160
feelWords.drill: tempo 140-146, sliding 808 on and-of-3, hats x.xx.xx.x.xx.x.x

lanes.name: Techno: peak-time and driving (Beyer, Eli Brown, de Witte) + hypnotic Berlin
lanes.laws: hardest kick of any lane; the rumble (ducked reverbed sub) is the bass; empty mids; 16 or 32-bar sections

bass.rumble: sub sine root dur 3.9 duck true drive 0.3 reverb 0.25 lowpass 140; sidechainDb 10-12
bass.hint: peak-time riff = 1-2 notes at octave 0, cutoff 300 to 2500 over 16 bars

harmony.stab: fatsawtooth unison 3 spread 40 decay 0.25 on steps 7 and 15, delay 8n wet 0.25
harmony.pad: sawtooth unison 3 cutoff 600 attack 1.5 -16 dB width 1
harmony.acid: arp sawtooth res 8 env 3 cutoff 200 to 3000

references: Adam Beyer & Bart Skils - Your Mind (2018, 126, B minor): one filtered riff + vocal
Eli Brown - Diamonds On My Mind (2023, 136, Bb minor): pop hook, driving groove
Charlotte de Witte - Doppler (2019, 135, Bb major): hypnotic 2-note motif

feelWords.harder: kick drive 0.5 drumDecay 0.4, tempo +3, sidechainDb 12, hats 16ths
feelWords.darker: clap on 2 only, tomB, pad cutoff 400, tempo 128
feelWords.rolling: bass roll, swing 0.55, ride quarters, rim pair
feelWords.hypnotic: no clap, 2-note arp delay 8n. wet 0.4, automation only
feelWords.rave: stab unison 4 spread 45 on 7 and 15, -5 dB

lanes.name: Trance: uplifting 136-140 and hard trance 145-150
lanes.laws: bass on every 16th between kicks, 8-12 dB duck; hats 12 dB under the kick; harmonic minor leads; breakdown longer than the drop; build ends in silence

bass.hint: dur 0.12; X 100 x 90; vary the last note every 4 bars; sub sine same pattern; sidechainDb 10

harmony.pad: fatsawtooth unison 4 spread 30 cutoff 800-6000 attack 0.8 -11 dB width 1; gate 2 in builds
harmony.lead: fatsawtooth unison 4 spread 35 cutoff 1500-6000 delay 8n width 1; epiano first

references: Darude - Sandstorm (1999, 136, B minor): 16th riff, hoover build
Tiesto - Adagio For Strings (2005, 140, Bb minor): strings as the breakdown
Marlon Hoffstadt - It's That Time (2024, 146, A minor): hard-trance revival

feelWords.harder: tempo 147, kick drive 0.45, hoover, rideHard swing 0.56
